This rental availability is derived primarily from some 50 property managers, multi-unit landlords, real estate brokerage houses, bank/trust concerns and individual small investors. Many of the larger concerns manage or own as many as 200 to 300 units in the lower price ranges and in virtually all areas of the county.
In addition, individual rental unit availabilities are obtained as a result of weekly advertisement under "Wanted to Rent" in the Milwaukee Journal and through the many people we come in contact with in the general project area.
